name: Saber Showdown
desc:
⚔️ Unleash your inner warrior and engage in epic duels. Unlock unique sabers by defeating others and use different abilities to compliment your playstyle. 

🚀 Join clans to engage in massive battles, climb the leaderboard, or play casually!

👍 New reward every 1000 likes! 💎 

📝DUELING GUIDE📝
https://devforum.roblox.com/t/-/2287354

🔒PRIVATE SERVERS🔒
Purchase a private server to access map commands!

💻CONTROLS🎮
One/ButtonX - Equip | Q/DPadUp - Ignite 
M1/R1 - Attack | M2/L1 - Block 
E/ButtonB - Slap | C/DPadDown - Saber Throw 
X/DPadRight - Swap Force | F/R2 - Use Force 
L/ButtonY - Mouse Lock | B/DPadLeft - Duel 

⚙️ Customize more controls in top left of screen. 

💨 Gain power focus by looking at enemies until you see smoke to use powers. 

🕹️COMBOS🕹️ 
Block + Attack: Disarm 
Block: Grab Saber/Ignite 
Jump + Attack: Special Attack 
Jump + Crouch: Roll 
Attack + Ignite: Feint
